literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe a C-terminal CFP fusion of full-length rat LRRTM1. LRRTM1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein: the large LRR ectodomain (residues 28–288) is extracellular, the TM spans 289–309, and the C-terminus (310–345) is intracellular. A C-terminal CFP therefore sits on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at the mature N-terminus (after residue 27), in any extracellular loop, or anywhere else on the extracellular face of LRRTM1. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal CFP fusion (LRRTM1-CFP) is functional and surface-displayed in a co-culture synaptogenic assay, but the C-terminus (residues 310–345) is intracellular; this is not an extracellular surface tag site.
